Name: Bunnydew Valley
Author: Arborian
Description:
Bunnydew Valley is a mod aiming to change everyone into Rabbits.
I love rabbits and want to make everyone rabbits!
Fur color is free game.

[/u]
[list]
[*]Penny (Portrait & Sprites)
[/list][u]

[/list]
I accept recommendations and tips on how to improve textures!
Please report and issues with the textures!
